title: wkask free AI CDP-direct routing
desc: wkask CDP-direct routing for 8 free web AIs not natively supported by Core: duck perplexity mistral deepseek hugging groq venice phind
steps: WHAT: wkask detects free-provider targets and routes via CDP-direct. Providers: duck=duck.ai perplexity=perplexity.ai mistral=chat.mistral.ai deepseek=chat.deepseek.com hugging=huggingface.co/chat groq=groq.com venice=venice.ai/chat phind=phind.com

PATTERN: a11y-first no eval-js for actions. (1) cdp open URL gets port. (2) a11y invoke consent banner via *agree*;*accept*;*continue* OR pattern. (3) a11y find grap#*Edit* then Get-VerifiedGrap parses TARGET line. (4) a11y set-value or a11y type with prompt. (5) a11y invoke send button OR a11y type --hotkey Enter fallback. (6) Start-Sleep 15 then a11y read --eval-js for response text only.
INVOKE-WK: Start-Process file-redirect avoids deadlock. Use -RedirectStandardOutput tmpF -PassThru -NoNewWindow then WaitForExit then Get-Content. NOT ProcessStartInfo+ReadToEnd.
CONSENT: duck.ai consent banner auto-dismissed via a11y invoke on *agree*;*accept* grap. Re-appears after wkcdp clean.
KNOWN-ISSUES: duck.ai CAPTCHA when bot-detected. groq and phind are most bot-tolerant. perplexity may need login.

A11Y-FIRST FIX (2026-05-19): Rewrote CDP block in wkask.ps1 to use a11y actions not eval-js. Consent: a11y invoke grap#*agree*. Input: a11y find grap#*Edit* -> Get-VerifiedGrap -> a11y type. Submit: a11y invoke send button OR a11y type --hotkey Enter. Response read: still a11y read --eval-js (no a11y equivalent). Invoke-WK fixed to Start-Process file-redirect (not ProcessStartInfo+ReadToEnd deadlock). Committed fe6fe405 in wkask-free-ai-cdp-routing wkask.ps1 Core repo.

GPT-DIRECT ROUTING (2026-05-20): Add gpt=chatgpt.com to cdpProviders. Use a11y set-value NOT a11y type for prompt-textarea (type triggers SendInput focus-guard in hidden window). grap must use domain:chatgpt.com not proc:chrome to target correct tab. Cookie banner: 'reject non-essential' button. Streaming poll: data-is-streaming attr. Response read: querySelectorAll data-message-author-role=assistant last element.
OPUS DELEGATION RESULT: set-value confirmed working. Final wkask.ps1 GPT routing uses set-value for text insert + hotkey Enter for submit + streaming poll + ChatGPT assistant selector for response.
